premarital_context.note: Premarital panels cover ~570 genes / >840 conditions (Gulf News), so these yields are NOT comparable with the single-gene yields above; they are shown for scale. Premarital testing is mandatory for Emiratis marrying from 1 Jan 2025 and reaches only couples before marriage; couples already married (all couples in the cascade simulation) are outside it. Per test, premarital screening of a random couple for one gene has the same expected yield as the 'random couples' comparator.
